meta.title: 对新手超级友好的4种出片姿势
meta.title_en: 4 Super Beginner-Friendly Poses That Photograph Well
meta.topic: 拍照姿势 · 新手教学

scenes.title_en: Standing: Pop the Hip First, Then Extend the Leg
scenes.context: 全身照不是直直地站着摆拍，而是先顶胯、再伸腿、手插腰、歪头。用动作顺序让姿态有曲线感。语域：姿势教学，口令式引导。
sentences: 全身不是这样拍，而是先顶胯，再伸腿。
For a full-body shot, don't pose like this — pop your hip first, then extend your leg.
full-body shot（全身照）；pop your hip（顶胯）
手插腰，歪头。
Hand on hip, head tilted.
hand on hip（手插腰）；head tilted（歪头）
中心放在右胯，歪头看扇子。
Shift your weight to your right hip, and tilt your head toward the fan.
shift your weight（重心转移）
paraphrase: 顶胯 → pop your hip / push your hip out
pop your hip · push your hip
重心转移 → shift your weight / lean into
scenes.speak: For a full-body shot, don't pose like this — pop your hip first, then extend your leg. Hand on hip, head tilted. Shift your weight to your right hip, and tilt your head toward the fan.

scenes.title_en: Leaning on a Pillar: Step Out and Lean With Your Shoulder
scenes.context: 拍柱子场景时不是直接靠上去，而是走出来一步，用肩膀去靠，姿态更自然松弛。语域：姿势教学，纠错示范。
sentences: 柱子不是直接靠在上面拍。
Don't just lean directly against the pillar when shooting.
lean against（靠在上面）
而是走出来一步，用肩膀去靠。
Instead, step out one pace and lean in with your shoulder.
step out（走出来一步）；lean with your shoulder（用肩膀靠）
用肩膀去靠，画面更松弛。
Leaning with your shoulder makes the shot look more relaxed.
more relaxed（更松弛）
paraphrase: 走出来一步 → step out one pace / take a step forward
更松弛 → more relaxed / more at ease
scenes.speak: Don't just lean directly against the pillar when shooting. Instead, step out one pace and lean in with your shoulder. Leaning with your shoulder makes the shot look more relaxed.

scenes.title_en: Tilting: Let the Head Fall Toward the Camera
scenes.context: 不要直直把脸冲向镜头，那会显脸方。反过来用脑袋倒向镜头、下巴向前伸，脸型更小更上镜。语域：姿势教学，纠错示范。
sentences: 歪头，不是把脸冲向镜头，显脸方。
When tilting, don't aim your face straight at the camera — it widens your face.
aim your face at（脸冲向）；widens your face（显脸方）
而是反过来，用脑袋倒向镜头。
Instead, do the reverse: let your head fall toward the camera.
the reverse（反过来）
下巴向前伸。
Chin forward.
chin forward（下巴前伸）
paraphrase: 显脸方 → widens your face / makes your face look wide
widens your face · face looks wide
下巴前伸 → chin forward / push your chin out
scenes.speak: When tilting, don't aim your face straight at the camera — it widens your face. Instead, do the reverse: let your head fall toward the camera. Chin forward.

scenes.title_en: Walking: Cross-Step for a Better Shot
scenes.context: 走路不是直直地往前走，而是腿交叉走交叉步，可以抬头歪头，动作链让抓拍更有生命力。语域：姿势教学，动感引导。
sentences: 走路不是这样直直地往前走。
Don't just walk straight ahead when you're being shot.
walk straight ahead（直直往前走）
而是腿交叉，走交叉步。
Instead, cross your legs and take cross steps.
cross steps（交叉步）
可以抬头，歪头。
You can look up and tilt your head.
look up（抬头）
paraphrase: 交叉步 → cross steps / crossing one foot over
抬头 → look up / lift your gaze
scenes.speak: Don't just walk straight ahead when you're being shot. Instead, cross your legs and take cross steps. You can look up and tilt your head.

practice: Pop your hip first, then extend your leg.
Step out one pace and lean in with your shoulder.
Let your head fall toward the camera and push your chin forward.
Cross your legs and take cross steps while you walk.
pitfalls: I stand straight like this to shoot.
Don't pose like this — pop your hip first.
摆姿势用 pose，站姿描述用 stand straight（直直站着）。
Step out one pace and lean in with your shoulder.
「用肩膀靠」是 lean with your shoulder，不是直接 lean on。
Face the camera to make my face small.
Let your head fall toward the camera — facing it straight widens your face.
脸冲向镜头只会显脸方；「显脸小」靠歪头前伸下巴。
Cross your legs and take cross steps.
「直走」是 walk straight ahead，强调交叉步用 cross steps。
shifts: 用 pop your hip（顶胯）、head tilted（歪头）、chin forward（下巴前伸）分解动作
说显脸小只会 look small
用 reverse the direction（反向）、head falls toward camera（脑袋倒向镜头）
用 cross steps（交叉步）、look up（抬头）、action chain（动作链）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：排→拍、踢头→歪头、依次步→交叉步、扇子→扇子等。
